title: Candidate rows in a catalog lookup
method: Synthetic catalog: 100,000 rows, 1,000 in one tenant, 100 matching that tenant and brand. Counts describe logical candidates, not observed execution time, index visits or universal planner behavior.
alt: Candidate rows in a catalog lookup. Whole catalog: 100000 candidate rows; Selected tenant: 1000 candidate rows; Tenant and brand: 100 candidate rows. Illustrative values.
